job.title: Manufacturing Supervisor
job.description:
The Company
The company is an established Australian manufacturer of practical livestock handling and agricultural equipment. Based in Wagga Wagga, it designs and builds durable, fit-for-purpose products for customers across Australia.
With local manufacturing at its core, the business values safety, quality workmanship and reliable delivery.

The Opportunity
The Manufacturing Supervisor will support the day-to-day running of the workshop, helping the team complete work safely, efficiently and to the required standard.

This hands-on role suits someone ready to take the next step into supervision. You will help organise priorities, guide the team and resolve routine production issues while remaining involved on the workshop floor.
Key Responsibilities

  • Help plan daily workshop activities and priorities
  • Allocate tasks and follow jobs through to completion
  • Provide practical support and direction to workshop employees
  • Monitor quality, output and delivery timeframes
  • Ensure drawings and job requirements are followed
  • Promote safe work practices and good housekeeping
  • Assist with equipment and production issues
  • Keep simple production records and communicate progress

About You
This role will suit a reliable manufacturing or fabrication professional with some experience guiding others and an interest in developing their supervisory skills.
We would like to speak with candidates who can demonstrate:

  • Experience in manufacturing, fabrication or a similar workshop environment
  • Some exposure to leading a small team, allocating work or training employees
  • The ability to read basic drawings and job specifications
  • A practical understanding of workshop equipment and fabrication processes
  • A sound approach to safety, quality and housekeeping
  • Good organisation and problem-solving skills
  • Clear communication and a dependable, hands-on attitude

A relevant trade qualification or experience with steel fabrication, agricultural equipment or project-based manufacturing would be an advantage.

Why This Role
This is a practical opportunity to step into workshop supervision with the support of an established Australian manufacturer. There are new and exciting changes happening at this company, come and be a part of it.

Please apply via the “Apply for this job” button or online at Rimfire Resources. For further information, please contact Mark Turner on 0401 404 451.

job.title: Manager - Business Development & Commercialisation
job.description:
The Company

AgriFutures is one of 15 Research and Development Corporations (RDC’s) that service the Research, Development and Extension needs of Australia rural industries. Funded through industry levies and the Australian government, they help industry and government by investing in R&D that supports the productivity, profitability, competitiveness and sustainability of rural industries. Their programs cover established and emerging industries, as well as addressing key challenges and important issues currently facing Australian agriculture and its workforce.

AgriFutures collaborate and connect with industries, representative organisations, RDC’s, government, researchers’ industry bodies and other partners to ensure research outcomes are translated into practical information, tools and activities.

This drives awareness, understanding, adoption and practice change.

The Opportunity

Within the Cross Sector research team, a new role has been created, Manager, Business Development & Commercialisation.

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Emerging Industries & Business Development, the role is responsible for diversifying external revenue through collaborations and partnerships. You will be involved in leveraging AgriFutures funds via strategic partnerships. This role is also responsible for driving commercialisation opportunities for AgriFutures .

The role is responsible for:

  • Diversifying external revenue through partnerships
  • Driving commercialisation within AgriFutures
  • Project management, governance and reporting

About You

To be successful in this role it is important to have:

  • Tertiary qualifications in business, agriculture, science, commercialisation, innovation or related field
  • Practical experience in research commercialisation and/or business development
  • Project management skills
  • Familiarity with collaborative funding, securing grants, contracts and co-investment
  • Stakeholder engagement experience
  • Strong writing and presentation skills

You may have experience working in a similar role for one of the RDC’s, universities, government agencies or rural industry suppliers.

This role is ideal if you have some funding and commercialisation experience, ready to learn and able to manage competing priorities in a high-volume working environment.

The role can be based in Wagga Wagga, Sydney or Canberra with a hybrid work from home arrangement, working in the office 3 days a week.

Why this role?

The team are energetic and people focused, driven by wanting to overcome challenges and strengthen rural industries through research, development and extension. You will be encouraged to be self-driven but working with a high-functioning team focused on delivering impact across Australia’s agricultural industries.

How to Apply

For a confidential discussion contact Al Kellaway at Rimfire Resources on 1300 380 701 or apply via rimfireresources.com.au.

job.title: Supply Chain Analyst
job.description:
The Company
Our client is an established agribusiness supplying essential agricultural inputs to customers across Australia.
Supported by an extensive storage, distribution and logistics network, the business works closely with agricultural customers and supply chain partners to deliver reliable products and services to key farming regions.

The Opportunity
This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career supply chain or logistics professional to develop their analytical, planning and stakeholder management capabilities within a complex national operation.

Reporting to the Shipping Manager, you will support the planning and coordination of inbound product movements across eastern Australia. Based primarily in the Port Melbourne head office, the role will focus on analysing schedules and operational performance, preparing reports, coordinating stakeholders and identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, service and cost outcomes.

You will work with information from across the supply chain to monitor progress, investigate potential issues and support informed operational decisions. While primarily office-based, the position will involve targeted attendance at ports, warehouses or other operational sites to build your understanding of the broader supply chain.

Key responsibilities will include:

  • Assist with the planning and monitoring of inbound shipping and product movements
  • Analyse operational data, schedules, costs and service performance
  • Prepare reports and provide clear insights to support decision-making
  • Monitor vessel movements and transport readiness
  • Coordinate with shipping agents, logistics providers, warehouse operators and internal teams
  • Identify delays, risks or operational issues and support practical solutions
  • Assist with reviewing contractor performance and supply chain outcomes
  • Maintain accurate operational records and documentation
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives across shipping and logistics activities
  • Contribute to the business's safety, compliance and product integrity requirements

As the role supports live supply chain activities, there may occasionally be a need to respond to time-sensitive issues outside standard business hours.

The Person
We are seeking an analytical and relationship-focused professional who is interested in building a career in supply chain, logistics or agribusiness operations.

You may already be working in supply chain analysis, logistics coordination, transport, shipping, procurement, inventory planning or a related operational environment. Direct port or vessel discharge experience is not essential.

To be successful, you will ideally offer:

  • Approximately 2-5 years' experience in supply chain, logistics, transport, shipping, procurement or operations
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Confidence working with operational data, reports and schedules
  • Good Excel skills and the ability to interpret information and identify trends
  • Strong stakeholder relationship and communication skills
  • The ability to coordinate several activities and priorities at once
  • Commercial awareness and a genuine interest in improving cost, service and efficiency
  • Good attention to detail and a structured approach to your work
  • A willingness to learn about shipping, agricultural supply chains and operational compliance
  • A current driver's licence and flexibility to occasionally visit operational sites

Experience within agribusiness, fertiliser, bulk commodities, transport or warehousing would be beneficial but is not essential.

Why This Role?
This newly created role offers the opportunity to build practical experience across shipping, logistics and supply chain analysis within an established global agribusiness.

You will work with a broad group of internal and external stakeholders, gain exposure to a complex national supply chain and contribute to operational reporting and continuous improvement. Practical onboarding and support will be provided, with the scope of the position growing as your knowledge and capability develop.

For further information or a confidential discussion, please contact Ryan Hoiberg on 1300 380 701. Applications can be submitted via www.rimfireresources.com.au.

job.title: Territory Manager & Product Development Manager - Central Queensland
job.description:
The Company
Terranova Seeds is a specialist vegetable seeds company with more than 40 years’ experience. They supply commercial growers across Australia and New Zealand with a wide range of vegetable varieties and technical support. The business also exports selected products to the USA, SE Asia, PNG, the Pacific Islands, and customers in Europe, Africa, and Central America.

Partnering with leading international breeding companies, Terranova Seeds has grown consistently and become a market leader. With experienced technical staff, they provide high‑quality seed solutions trialled under local conditions to ensure reliability. The company is known for exceptional service, strong client relationships, and ongoing growth both locally and globally. Quality of product is their mantra.

The Opportunity
Reporting to the National Sales Manager, this is a unique role that does not come along often. A hybrid function combining your sales and client management skills with product development responsibilities.

Your product development function will focus on the ongoing development of new products in the wider Queensland, gathering robust trial data forecasting and maintaining supplier relationships for existing and potential new commercial lines. You will do this by working closely with the National Product Development Manager, overseeing product development across the region as required while being highly connected to the end user, suppliers and client base in the supply of specific vegetable seed products. Focusing on crops such as tomatoes, peppers, cucurbits, green bean and sweetcorn. Overall, you are pivotal to delivering the desired products to an established and loyal client base while building a pipeline of products to introduce to growers in the future.

Your sales focus is about business development. You will be to grow and develop revenue and gross profit within the region by sourcing and driving sales opportunities within the existing client base, while targeting new business clients for Terranova. Your selling skills and ability to influence and convert sales is vital for this role.

You will:

  • Grow sales, volume and gross profit in the region to targets
  • Be present in the region looking for growth opportunities with existing and new clients
  • Spend the majority of your time client engaged developing sales and product development
  • Oversee ongoing trialling, development and launch of new vegetable varieties
  • Gather and report quality trial data to support new varieties (so you will be hands on)
  • Work closely with the product development team and sales team nationally to forecast sales, supply and inventory needs

About you

To be successful in this role you will ideally have:

  • Proven sales skills and experience in a similar environment
  • Technical experience in the vegetable seed industry and a sound knowledge of agronomy
  • Direct experience in running ongoing vegetable trial programs and reporting outcomes
  • Strong report writing skills with accuracy/attention to detail supported by exceptional written and verbal communication skills
  • A natural ability and experience to listen and work positively with clients, suppliers, and growers
  • Relevant tertiary qualifications

Terranova offer a positive work culture where you will be provided with generous salary package including base, superannuation, car, phone, laptop and participate in the Company’s bonus plans. You will be expected to undertake local and international travel.

This is a unique opportunity with Terranova; an agile specialist vegetable seeds company which delivers tailored and ethical service delivery to its clients. A place where you have the flexibility to make decisions and lead by example yet work in a team environment.

For a confidential conversation please call David Jackson on 1300 380 701 or apply with a cover letter addressing the advertisement criteria and a fresh resume.

  • Managing controlled atmosphere store loading, sealing, release decisions, and container/pallet pooling arrangements to preserve shelf life and outturn quality.
  • Establishing master data governance across core systems, building advanced reporting and decision support capabilities, and elevating the supply chain from reactive execution to a scalable, best-practice operating model.

The ideal candidate will be a commercially astute, data-driven supply chain leader who performs effectively in a fast-paced, seasonal environment and can maintain a clear, evidence-based position when priorities compete or operating pressure increases.

  • A relevant tertiary qualification in Supply Chain Management, Planning, Business, or an aligned discipline.
  • A minimum of ten years of senior supply chain leadership experience within FMCG, fresh produce, food processing, meat, dairy, or cold-chain environments.
  • Proven experience designing, implementing, and running mature S&OP / IBP processes in a multi-site setting.
  • Deep technical capability across domestic and international logistics, export market protocols, cold-chain management and procurement governance.

Working closely with managers across the business and the leadership team, you’ll oversee the delivery of core HR activities including:

  • Day-to-day HR operations and employee support

  • HR systems, records and reporting

You’ll need to be comfortable moving between the detail and the bigger picture, whether that means working through an employee issue, improving a process, checking documentation or helping a manager navigate a difficult conversation.

About you
We’re looking for someone who has solid HR experience but doesn’t need a highly structured corporate environment around them.
You’ll ideally be:

  • Hands-on and delivery focused with a strong bias towards action
  • Organised, methodical and good at following things through
  • Strong on HR process, governance and compliance
  • Commercial and pragmatic in the way you approach HR
  • Approachable and capable of building relationships across all levels
  • A clear, straightforward communicator who doesn't hide behind HR jargon
  • Comfortable working with both managers and frontline employees
  • Confident dealing with sensitive or challenging people matters
  • Able to bring structure and discipline without making things unnecessarily bureaucratic
  • Comfortable working independently and using good judgement

Experience within agriculture, agribusiness, food production, manufacturing, transport, resources or another operationally focused industry would be well regarded. More important, though, is that you understand how to work with practical, busy people and can adapt your approach accordingly.

The opportunity
This role will suit someone who enjoys travel, being close to the business and close to the people.
